question: Six students Subham, Sneha, Surbhi, Muskan, Harsh and Vishal are standing in an assembly line facing north (one behind the other). Only one person stands behind Harsh in the line. Sneha stands exactly between Vishal and Muskan, Surbhi stands between Muskan and Harsh. Who stands immediately behind Surbhi?
solution:
